description: Implementation of QuicDataWriter class for writing data in QUIC protocol, including methods for writing various data types, connection IDs, and random bytes.

classes.name: QuicDataWriter
classes.description: A class for writing data into a buffer with support for various data types and encoding.

methods.name: WriteUFloat16
methods.description: Encodes a 64-bit unsigned integer into a 16-bit float representation and writes it to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteConnectionId
methods.description: Writes a QuicConnectionId to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteLengthPrefixedConnectionId
methods.description: Writes a length-prefixed QuicConnectionId to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteRandomBytes
methods.description: Fills the buffer with cryptographically secure random bytes.

methods.name: WriteInsecureRandomBytes
methods.description: Fills the buffer with insecure random bytes.
